reads.sell: A Loire red of raspberry, red currant and violet with a pencil lead edge, light on its feet and bright with acidity. Served a little cool, it is lovely with charcuterie, roast chicken or goat's cheese.

why.grape: Crunchy red fruit with green bell pepper, jalapeño and pencil lead on a medium frame, lighter than Cabernet Sauvignon, is the Cabernet Franc signature.
why.climate: Tart red fruit, the pyrazine edge, medium plus acidity and moderate alcohol say a cool climate.
